objective: minimise (1 − IoU(atlasBrainMask, imageMask ∘ T)) on a 512×512 uniform canonical grid in the plane frame (planeGeometry.planeTransform)
optimiser: deterministic coarse-to-fine grid search, 3 stages, no RNG, no clock, no network
tieBreak: lowest cost, then smallest |Δu|+|Δv|+|su−1|+|sv−1|, then lexicographic (su, sv, duAu, dvAu)
signConvention: T maps a canonical position p to the position in the image’s own frame shown there: s = c + (p − c − Δ)/k, c = the centre of the grid’s own canonical rectangle (grids) / the plate’s placement centre (plates). k > 1 enlarges the image.
tissueRule: stains/*.png decoded in-script (node:zlib inflateSync + PNG filters 0–4); tissue = luminance < (median of the 8-px border bands − 12)
jpegReason: NOT measured — no JPEG decoder exists in this repo and no dependency may be added
